links.outcome: Nurse awareness of workplace AI policy governing patient care use
links.effect: 47.0% reported a workplace AI policy, 32.5% no policy, 20.5% unsure; uncertainty about policy was associated with lower use (aOR = 0.62 any use; 0.65 clinical frequency).
links.quote: Just under half of respondents (47.0%) reported that their workplace had a policy governing AI use in patient care, while 32.5% reported no policy and 20.5% were unsure.

unlisted_practices: Frontline supervisor and organizational support for generative AI use (correlated with use, not safety)

links.outcome: Reported absence of workplace policy governing AI use in patient care
links.effect: 32.5% reported no workplace AI policy; 47.0% reported a policy and 20.5% were unsure. Policy existence was self-reported, not independently verified.
